reference: NASA TMR theoretical Karman-Schoenherr and SSTm CFL3D
limits: Two grids do not establish grid independence; the local-edge approximation differs from the nominal-freestream formula used for the NASA reference.

openfoam.status: iteration limit; no stopping criterion configured
openfoam.notes: Identical converted grid and fixed omega at wall. Different turbulence implementations, discretization, startup and pressure solver tolerance; wall friction on both calculated using the first-cell velocity and wall distance.

error_measure: Unweighted mean absolute relative error at 41 nonuniform wall sample locations; references interpolated at local-edge Re_theta.
integration_method: Local edge velocity is interpolated at y=0.05; theta integrates (u/Ue)*(1-u/Ue) from wall to y=0.05; Re_theta=Ue*theta/nu; Cf=2*tau_wall/(rho*Ue^2).
edge_height_sensitivity: At y=0.1 the FLURSYS mean relative difference to NASA changes from 1.07% to approximately 1.12%; reference interval and x sampling are unchanged.
previous_analysis_correction: Earlier full-height integration using inlet speed introduced large negative outer-flow contributions; the previously reported 9.51% is superseded.
default_example_note: The example uses the NASA reference mesh and matched turbulence settings. The previous regenerated mesh presets were removed because a tested preset failed.
reference_profile_note: Profiles are near Re_theta=10000 and not exactly the same station; qualitative comparison.
